close_reason: Added rust,no_run lib.rs Usage doc-tests to all 7 client crates following the tasks-client template. docs.rs landing pages now show a 'fetch_session + with_*_session + a list/get call' example consistently. All 25 workspace doc-tests pass; clippy/fmt clean.
